<parameter=code>
# Let me try cycling through all states of slot 0 and check if any matches any top pattern
def inner_5x5_compact(lines, rs, cs):
    inner = tuple(lines[rs+r][cs+1:cs+6] for r in range(1,6))
    return ''.join(['#' if c == 'B' else '.' for row in inner for c in row])

init_ascii = history[0].frame.ascii.split('\n')

# Top patterns (all 12)
all_top = []
tile_pos = [(4,12), (4,22), (4,35), (4,45), (13,12), (13,22), (13,35), (13,45), (22,12), (22,22), (22,35), (22,45)]
for rs, cs in tile_pos:
    all_top.append(inner_5x5_compact(init_ascii, rs, cs))

# Current cursor is at slot 0
# Cycle through states and check for matches
seen = set()
matches = []
for step in range(20):
    curr_ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    p = inner_5x5_compact(curr_ascii, 51, 18 + 0*7)
    if p in seen:
        print(f"Cycle detected at step {step}")
        break
    seen.add(p)
    # Check if this state matches any top pattern
    for j, t in enumerate(all_top):
        if p == t:
            matches.append((step, j, t))
            print(f"State at step {step} matches top pattern {j}: {t}")
    action(['UP'])

print(f"\nTotal states seen: {len(seen)}")
print(f"Matches found: {len(matches)}")

# Also check sky blue bottom patterns against top patterns
s_bottom = [inner_5x5_compact(curr_ascii, 40, 18 + i*7) for i in range(5)]
print("\nSky blue bottom vs all top:")
for i, s in enumerate(s_bottom):
    matches = [j for j, t in enumerate(all_top) if s == t]
    if matches:
        print(f"  Sky blue {i} matches top {matches}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
